sentences.en: Only two applicants made it onto the shortlist.
sentences.zh: 只有两名申请人进入了最终候选名单。

sentences.en: Nobody knows the shortlist of nominees for Japanese ambassador to Colombia yet.
sentences.zh: 目前还没有人知道日本驻哥伦比亚大使的候选人名单。

sentences.en: The HR department will review all applications and create a shortlist.
sentences.zh: 人力资源部将审核所有申请并制作一份候选人短名单。
